Meta.title: Taksu Tech block-coding playground
Meta.description: Snap code blocks together, run them, and help the robot bring rice to the jineng. See the generated C++ and Python too.

Playground.title: Bring the rice to the jineng
Playground.backToSite: Back to the Taksu Tech website
Playground.stageLabel: Rice field where the robot moves

code.title: Program code
code.blocksNote: In primary school, students only snap blocks together. In junior high, the same program is shown as C++ for the ESP32 robot and as Python.
code.empty: Add blocks under the when-started block to see the code.

errors.noStart: The program needs a when-started block. Find it in the Start category.

success.title: You did it!
success.body: The rice reached the jineng. Suksma, robot!

crash.title: Oops, the robot bumped into something
crash.body: There is a duck or a field edge ahead. Change the block order and try again.

incomplete.title: Not there yet
incomplete.body: The program finished, but the robot is not at the jineng.

timeout.title: The program keeps looping
timeout.body: The robot ran for too long. Check your repeat block and its condition.

straight.title: Straight to the jineng
straight.goal: Bring the robot to the jineng ahead of it.
straight.hint: Change the number on the forward block until the robot stops right at the jineng.

turn.title: Turn at the field edge
turn.goal: The jineng is at the top of the field.
turn.hint: Go forward, turn left, then go forward again.

duck.title: Watch out for the duck!
duck.goal: Deliver the rice without bumping into the duck.
duck.hint: Go around the duck: turn, go forward, then turn back.

subak.title: Follow the subak channel
subak.goal: Follow the water channel all the way to the jineng.
subak.hint: Use repeat until arrived. Inside it: if there is water ahead go forward, otherwise check left or right.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: This address does not exist in the playground.
